import re
HEAD = re.compile(r"^Pattern has (?P<elts>\d+) elts \(size (?P<size>\d+)\)\s*$")
PROP = re.compile(r"^\t(?P<key>\w+):(?: (?P<rest>.*))?$")
TOKEN = re.compile(r"(\"[^\"]*\"|[^\s\"]+?)((?:\([a-z=]\))+|(?=\s|$))")
PAGE = re.compile(r"^\t(?P<page>[0-9a-f]+): (?P<bits>[0-9a-f]+(?: [0-9a-f]+)*)$")
ANN = re.compile(r"^\((?P<ann>[a-z=])\)$")
LETTER = {"i": "int", "f": "double", "s": "strong", "w": "weak", "=": "same"}


def annotate(row, ann):
    for a in re.findall(r"\(([a-z=])\)", ann):
        col = "binding" if a in "sw=" else "type"
        word = LETTER.get(a, a)
        if word not in row[col].split(","):
            row[col] = (row[col] + "," + word) if row[col] else word


def parse(lines):
    head, props, pages = {}, [], []
    hl, pl, cl = [], [], []
    cur = None
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = HEAD.match(ln)
        if m:
            head.update({"elts": m.group("elts"), "size": m.group("size")})
            hl.append(i)
            continue
        m = PROP.match(ln)
        if m:
            cur = {"property": m.group("key"), "value": "", "type": "", "binding": ""}
            props.append(cur)
            pl.append(i)
            vals = []
            for val, ann in TOKEN.findall(m.group("rest") or ""):
                if val.startswith("\"") and val.endswith("\"") and len(val) >= 2:
                    val = val[1:-1]
                vals.append(val)
                annotate(cur, ann)
            cur["value"] = ",".join(vals)
            continue
        m = PAGE.match(ln)
        if m and cur is not None:
            pages.append({"property": cur["property"], "page": m.group("page"), "bits": m.group("bits")})
            cur["value"] = (cur["value"] + "," + m.group("page")) if cur["value"] else m.group("page")
            cl.append(i)
            continue
        m = ANN.match(ln)
        if m and cur is not None:
            annotate(cur, ln)
            pl.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = [
        {"name": "pattern", "kind": "kv", "lines": hl, "records": [head]},
        {"name": "properties", "kind": "table", "lines": pl, "records": props},
        {"name": "charset", "kind": "table", "lines": cl, "records": pages},
    ]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": []}
